description: Place a limit order to buy or sell outcome shares at a specific price on Polymarket CLOB. Requires POLYMARKET_PRIVATE_KEY. Billed at $0.10 USDC via LemonCake.

expiration.description: Order time-in-force: GTC=Good Till Cancel (default), GTD=till date, FOK=Fill or Kill, IOC=Immediate or Cancel

price.description: Limit price (0–1, representing probability/cents per share). E.g. 0.65 = 65 cents.

size.description: Number of shares to buy or sell

token_id.description: Outcome token ID (YES or NO) from get_market

name: place_limit_order
